resources.string: \"AdSkip\" uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to automatically skip ads. It is open source, needs no network, and is completely safe! To make sure it works properly, please check the following settings:
1. In \"Accessibility\" settings, turn on \"AdSkip - Accessibility Service\".
2. In \"Battery optimization\" settings, set \"AdSkip\" to \"Not optimized\".
3. In battery management, set \"AdSkip\" to \"Allow background power usage\". The steps vary by brand. For example, on VIVO: \"Settings\" -> \"Battery\" -> \"Background power usage management\".

\"AdSkip\" uses Android\'s Accessibility Service to automatically skip ads. Please turn on this service so it can work properly.\n\nThis app is open source, needs no network permission, and does not collect or upload any personal information. You can use it with confidence!

"AdSkip" can help you automatically skip splash ads in some apps, using Android's Accessibility Service. 

It can skip splash ads in three ways: 

1. Keywords. It looks for buttons containing keywords in an app and automatically clicks them to skip the ad; 
2. Specific controls. When an app is running, it automatically finds the matching control and clicks it; 
3. Specific positions. When an app is running, it automatically taps the matching area. 

You can configure all three methods in "Settings". 

For details, visit:
Please read before turning on the Accessibility Service

"AdSkip" reads the current screen's UI content (control text, descriptions, and positions) through Android's Accessibility Service to identify and automatically tap the "Skip" button on splash ads.

· During automatic detection, this content is only compared in memory on your device and is not saved.
· When you use "Add a skip method for an app", the text, description, and coordinates of the controls you select are saved as rules in this app's data on your device, where you can view or delete them in Settings.
· When you use "Copy window widgets", the current window's widget info is copied to the system clipboard when you tap.

This app does not request network permission and does not collect or upload any data. Once you agree, the Accessibility Service can be turned on; before you agree, the service will not read any screen content.
